name: grid-pixelate-wipe
title: Grid Pixelate Wipe
description: Transition effect where the screen dissolves into a grid of squares that fade out with staggered timing — use between scenes. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="grid-pixelate-wipe": its own timeline nests there, 1.2 s long, with the frame fully covered at 0.6 s, where the cut goes.
